newsitem.title: UK: CU shares gain as results beat forecasts.
newsitem.headline: CU shares gain as results beat forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc rose in early trade on Wednesday after the insurance group's first-half results beat analyst expectations.
The stock was first quoted up 7p at 696-1/2p at 0721 GMT, with volume reaching 35,000 shares.

Pre-tax operating profit rose 8.8 percent to 235 million stg, compared with analyst forecasts mostly in a range between 209 million stg and 228 million stg. The dividend was raised to 12.25 pence, as expected.
"We knew the UK business would lag but there are signs that the French business is booming," one trader said. "The stock has also been dull versus the rest of the sector in recent months."
The company said operating profits before tax were up 25 percent at constant exchange rates.

"Our exposure to fast developing life and savings markets, particularly in Europe, is generating substantial growth which will be of increasing value to our shareholders," said chief executive John Carter.
